ModMetaData.name: Material Numbers
ModMetaData.author: Material Numbers contributors
ModMetaData.description:
【简体中文】 材料数值是一款面向 RimWorld 1.6 的可配置材料对比工具，可将所有已加载材料的库存数量与属性整理为可排序的表格。
主要功能： • 自动发现游戏及其他 Mod 提供的材料定义与可读取属性。 • 自由选择、拖动和缩放列，并保存为全局自定义预设。 • 使用“=、×、+”区分基础值、材料倍率和材料加成。 • 提供概览、建造、护甲与衣物、采集与生产、舒适与睡眠、交易与库存六套内置预设。 • 可按材料大类、当前地图或当前储存区筛选，并支持名称搜索与列排序。 • 可识别 Survival Tools Lite 工具属性，不强制依赖 Harmony、HSK 或其他 Mod。
【English】 Material Numbers is a configurable material comparison tool for RimWorld 1.6. It presents inventory counts and properties from every loaded stuff definition in a sortable table.
Features: • Automatically discovers material definitions and readable stats supplied by the game and other mods. • Choose, reorder, and resize columns, then save layouts as global custom presets. • Distinguishes base values, material factors, and material offsets with “=”, “×”, and “+”. • Includes six built-in presets: Overview, Construction, Armor and Apparel, Gathering and Production, Comfort and Rest, and Trade and Stock. • Filters by broad material group, current map, or current storage, with material search and column sorting. • Recognizes Survival Tools Lite tool stats without requiring Harmony, HSK, or any other mod.
